how_to_use: pelias import profiles/reference_pelias/pelias_machine_profile.json (or drop it on the Import screen). Hardware facts are replaced by the start-up probe when it measures the same quantity; settings arrive as proposals.

applies_to.machine_state_sha: computed by the probe at first start

drives.D: WD SN580 NVMe at PCIe 3.0 x2 (archives, WSL2 swap)
drives.label: MEASURED (HWiNFO records)

measured_floors.label: MEASURED, Wave 0 and microbenchmarks 02-07; values are WSL2 / Windows

plan_basis.basis_note: Peaks below are whole-card NVML readings (they include about 0.9-1.0 GiB held by Windows). The governor enforces the process-only ceiling (decision 7, ruled 2026-10-24), which on this machine leaves about 1.0-1.3 GiB more room; so the recommendation of PELIAS_SYSTEM_MASTERWORK.md 7.6 is expected to fire on the first run.
plan_basis.source: whole-card peaks of the llama.cpp tier build; the Pelias engine's own peaks are unmeasured (P-E4)
plan_basis.label: MEASURED peaks; AUTHOR-STATED ceiling (D26)

recommend_rule: If the measured ceiling is higher than plan_basis.vram_ceiling_gib, re-solve the plan and list every setting that changes (old, new, why, gain, risk); nothing continues until the user accepts or declines (PELIAS_SYSTEM_MASTERWORK.md 7.6).
